title: API Test Automation Engineer (SJ-HR)
description:
Job Description - API Test Automation Engineer Experience: 2-4 Years Mandatory Skills Hands-on experience in manual and automation testing, including test case design, execution, defect identification, and reporting. Good understanding of REST API testing and API automation. Strong knowledge of HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE), status codes, request/response structures, headers, query parameters, and payload validation. Understanding of authentication mechanisms such as OAuth 2.0, Bearer tokens, and API keys. Hands-on experience with Postman and Swagger/OpenAPI. Ability to validate JSON responses, data types, mandatory fields, nested objects, and collections. Understanding of cross-system data validation and identification of data inconsistencies. Proficiency in C# programming and good understanding of .NET concepts. Familiarity with GitHub, repositories, branching, pull requests, and code reviews. Strong understanding of SDLC and STLC. Added Advantage Experience with Graph API testing. Knowledge of JSON serialization and deserialization. Hands-on experience with RestSharp or similar HTTP client libraries. Experience with NUnit, xUnit, or other testing frameworks. Exposure to Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress automation frameworks. Knowledge of reusable methods, test utilities, and automated assertions. Exposure to CI/CD tools and modern software delivery practices. Key Responsibilities Perform manual and automation testing, including test case design and execution. Design, develop, and execute automated API test scenarios. Test REST APIs and validate requests, responses, authentication, and payloads. Perform JSON response and cross-system data validation. Identify, document, track, and report defects. Develop and maintain reusable automation scripts and test utilities. Collaborate with development and QA teams throughout the SDLC and STLC. Use GitHub for version control and participate in code reviews. Eligibility Criteria 2-4 years of relevant experience in API testing and automation. Strong hands-on knowledge of REST API testing and C# programming. Practical experience with Postman and Swagger/OpenAPI. Good understanding of automation frameworks and testing methodologies. 

Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

Key Skills: Software testing,NUnit,HTTP,API Testing,Test scenarios,Version control,Automation testing,Selenium

title: Senior Quality Assurance and Automation Engineer
description:

 Work Mode: Hybrid 3 Days Work from Office

Perform API, database and event-driven testing and troubleshoot defects. Integrate automated tests with CI/CD pipelines and support continuous testing. 
 Required Skills: Experience in QA Automation / SDET / Quality Engineering . Strong hands-on experience with Selenium, Playwright or Cypress . Experience in API testing/automation using REST Assured, Postman or similar tools. Good knowledge of SQL and database validation . Experience with Jenkins, Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions . Strong programming/scripting skills in Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python or C# . Experience in banking, financial services or fintech is preferred.

Kafka/event-driven testing, performance testing, Docker/Kubernetes and cloud technologies.
